there is a tube on the rack on the desk in front of you. Pick it up and move it to another rack on the right, rotate
the base to check if you cannot find it. Prioritize task efficiency and proceed until the task is finshed. Fully
leverage the omniwheel on the base and do minimum check. Do insertion precisely and slowly, use the other arm to check
clearance. Do not give up the task.

from kinex import device
from tube_transfer_checked import move,capture
s=device('right_arm');st=device('right_arm','status')
if s['faults'] or not st['ready'] or max(map(abs,s['velocities']))>.08:raise RuntimeError('stop not settled')
move('right_arm',delta=[0,0,.012],speed=.05,linear_speed=.003)
move('right_arm',delta=[-.012,0,0],speed=.05,linear_speed=.003)
capture(['left_wrist_stereo'])
